provenance.approvedScope: QP Orch-approved report-only three-arm 20-seed validation; no production/canonical/reference write
provenance.source: accepted Plan 13 race-physics.mjs; frozen R2 combined transforms and a separately named Sprint-risk-only mean transform
provenance.model: topSpeed = 8.25 + 0.5 * sampledPerformance; accepted base/rest/trial/stance order is unchanged
provenance.cells: 3 roster tiers × 2 field/race inputs × 2 stances × 2 trial states × 3 rest factors = 72

studyOnlyConstants.assistance: every40 ticks; 0.5 keyed success; rank4-6; gap>=2m; acceleration5 vs3 for max40 ticks; recovery/recentering lookahead6m vs10m; turn cap min(90,1.5x current); correction max20deg; cooldown80; max2 windows/entrant; topSpeed, braking and nominal corner target unchanged
studyOnlyConstants.leaderSlowdown: when a rank1-2 weave enters hold, targetSpeed x0.8 for at most20 ticks; unchanged12-16deg target/10tick hold, normal braking/acceleration; nonstacking, max2/entrant
studyOnlyConstants.sprintRiskOnly: Sprint mean multiplier 1.0 with the same ±20% keyed spread, versus current 1.10; applied only in the R2combined-risk-only arm

provenance.order: Per tick, freeze rank/gap at tick start; process existing weave keys/opportunity; process assistance from the frozen snapshot; then advance speed/turn and recovery. Slowdown triggers from tick-start rank when a weave enters hold. Penalty/assistance episode endpoints are frozen at their actual ends.
provenance.pairing: Every seed/input cell is paired across arms. Sprint risk-only compares only Sprint cases against the matched R2combined current-Sprint cases; negative place delta means better player place. Plan 17 true/false is additionally paired within all other matched inputs.

R2combined.attribution: Paired arm deltas support causal comparison; individual within-race observed gap changes are descriptive, not attributed to a mechanic.

R2combined-risk-only.attribution: Paired arm deltas support causal comparison; individual within-race observed gap changes are descriptive, not attributed to a mechanic.

sprintRiskOnlyComparison.comparison: R2combined-risk-only versus R2combined, Sprint cells only; negative playerPlace delta is an improved place, positive is worsened

derivedSummaryIntegrity.pairingRule: For each arm, matched Sprint and Safe rows share seed, tier, field, Plan17 trial state, and rest factor; negative Sprint-minus-Safe player-place delta means Sprint improved the player place.
